description: The celestial Ganga (heavenly river). All souls — Pandavas, Kauravas, allies, enemies — bathe in the sacred waters and achieve Moksha (liberation). The cycle ends. All debts paid. Svargarohana Parva — Moksha.

vn_backdrop_notes.mood: Peace, unity, transcendence, the dissolution of all conflict.
interactive_elements: All characters in their divine forms
vn_backdrop_notes.note: The game's final scene. Everyone — hero, villain, victim, perpetrator — is freed. The Mahabharata ends not with victory, but with release.
